# EvModal

> A modal is a focused overlay dialog that interrupts the current flow to present information or request a decision, blocking interaction with the page behind it until dismissed. Available for desktop and mobile.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:modal` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvModal } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvModal>` or `<ev-modal>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/modal/EvModal.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<div class="ev-modal__panel">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvModal
  title="Setujui pengajuan?"
  subtext="Tindakan ini tercatat di riwayat."
>
  Isi modal.
</EvModal>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Modal**, frame `4282:80755` (Modal). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use a modal for focused, decision-critical tasks that must interrupt the flow: confirmations, short forms, or important information the user must acknowledge before continuing.

### When not to use

- Don't use for long forms or multi-step flows — use a dedicated page or drawer (`evoq-ui:drawer`). Don't use for non-blocking, dismissible feedback — use a Toast, Alert (`evoq-ui:alert`), or inline message instead.

### Do

- Lead with a clear title and a primary action. Pick a Size that fits the content (Small for confirmations, Large for richer content). On mobile, stack actions full-width with the primary on top.

### Don't

- Don't stack multiple modals or remove the close affordance for dismissible dialogs. Don't overflow the modal with content that scrolls excessively — move it to a full page.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvModal`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<div class="ev-modal__panel">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:modal` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
